name: dazzer-plate
description: Your plate from your Dazzer board in a pane beside the chat, in Claude Code: what needs you now, what waits on someone else, and what is coming up. It opens only when you type /plate, and reads through the Dazzer connection you already have, carrying none of its own.

plate.title: Plate pane
plate.description: command: /plate opens your plate in a pane. off: no /plate at all. It never opens by itself.
